text: 华福证券宏观首席分析师陈兴表示，当前A股核心资产估值已较充分反映市场谨慎预期，权益市场配置价值逐步凸显，后续只要盈利端边际企稳、流动性预期温和修复，权益资产便具备向上修复弹性。他建议投资者规避短期情绪干扰，避免恐慌式离场，聚焦业绩与估值匹配度较好的优质标的，保持理性、耐心布局。
text_en: Chen Xing, Chief Macro Analyst at Huafu Securities, stated that the valuation of A-share core assets has already fully reflected cautious market expectations, and the allocation value of the equity market is gradually becoming prominent. As long as earnings stabilize at the margin and liquidity expectations recover moderately, equity assets will have upward repricing elasticity. He advises investors to avoid short-term sentiment interference, avoid panic selling, focus on high-quality names with good earnings-valuation matching, and maintain rational and patient positioning.
